item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'review_diff_path=$(mktemp /tmp/kk-review-code-XXXXXXXX.patch)
git diff --cached --no-ext-diff > "$review_diff_path"
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$review_diff_path"
cat "$review_diff_path"
git show :formatting.py
git show :tests/test_report.py'
